File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to handle any currency symbol/code (such as ₹ and CHF) rather than only the hardcoded €, $, £, ¥ regex.
args.title: Update parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to support ₹ and CHF

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/util/money.ts uses a regex `[\s€$£¥]` to strip currency symbols, which misses ₹ and alphabetical currency codes like CHF. Updating parseAmount in src/util/money.ts will handle any currency symbol/code instead of only hardcoded €, $, £, ¥.
